subject.title: Feature Request: Agent-triggered context compaction (self-compact tool)

question: Should an in-run model be allowed to request compaction of only its own current live session through `session_status`?
rationale: This introduces a model-originated mutation of active session state; automation cannot decide whether that authority belongs in the agent tool contract even though a narrow implementation path is available.

options.title: Allow Current-Session Only
options.body: Approve a fail-closed action limited to the live current session and routed through the existing recovery lifecycle.

options.title: Keep Operator-Only Control
options.body: Treat automatic compaction plus the shipped CLI/RPC as sufficient and decline model-originated compaction.

recommendation.title: Allow Current-Session Only
recommendation.body: Approve a fail-closed action limited to the live current session and routed through the existing recovery lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant tool contract and adjacent session behavior trace most strongly to this feature-history owner.
